title: BIC InnovateX 2026
sub_heading: Build the Next Generation of AI-Powered Sustainable Ecosystems
description: BIC InnovateX 2026 is the flagship 48-hour national hackathon bringing together 300+ elite student innovators, software engineers, and domain researchers to solve real-world problems in generative AI, fintech inclusivity, climate intelligence, and decentralized systems.
venue: BIC Innovation Hub & Tech Pavilion, Hall A & B, Kathmandu

eligibility: Open to undergraduate and graduate students enrolled in accredited institutions.
Cross-institutional teams are permitted and encouraged.
All code must be authored during the 48-hour hacking window.
submission_guidelines: Working prototype hosted publicly or verifiable via live video demo.
Public GitHub repository containing clear README and setup instructions.
3-minute pitch video and slide deck submitted via Devpost before deadline.
code_of_conduct: Harassment-free environment for all participants regardless of background.
Strict adherence to academic and intellectual property integrity.
Zero tolerance for plagiarism or pre-built proprietary software.

evaluation_criteria.description: Novelty of approach and problem difficulty.
Architecture, code quality, stability, and tech stack complexity.
Potential for real-world adoption and user benefit.
Clarity of communication, demo execution, and Q&A defense.
